#GAM 1 - ENVIRONMENTAL VARIABLES AFFECTING CALANUS
How do these environmental factors contribute to where calanus sit in the water column?
```{r}
df_vertical$Month <- factor(df_vertical$Month, levels = c("1","2","3","4","5")) #convering Month into a factor 
#df_vertical$time_of_day=df_vertical$time_num
#creating a GAM with proportion of cumulative calanus as the response variable and covariates as described in the lines below
WC_position_gam_total <- gam(
  prop_cum_total ~ 
    s(Temp) +                #temperature
    s(Salinity) +           #salinity
    s(time_of_day)+              #time of day
    s(Light)+                   #light intensity
    s(max_depth) +            #max_depth
    ti(perc_depth, by=Month) +   #depth position with seasonality accounted for by month as a factor
                #maximum station depth
    ti(perc_depth, max_depth),    #Interaction between percent depth (perc_depth) and maximum depth (max_depth)
  family  = betar(link = "logit"), #beta family 
  method  = "REML",           #restricted maximum likelihood 
  select = T,                 #adding shrinkage to see if any variables need to be removed
  data    = df_vertical       #assigning a dataframe 
) 

summary(WC_position_gam_total) #summarising the GAM
plot_position_gam=plot(WC_position_gam_total) #plotting the GAM
#x1=data.frame(plot_position_gam[[5]]$x)
#y1=data.frame(plot_position_gam[[5]]$fit)
gam.check(WC_position_gam_total) #checking the GAM
```
